verdict.rationale: Column is an API-first bank. Its operations are documented as public APIs: accounts, wires, ACH, checks, realtime payments, webhooks, idempotency, and a sandbox. A published OpenAPI spec is confirmed by a live probe, an llms.txt file is also live, and community users independently call the documentation excellent and note that customers use the HTTP APIs directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Column's API is defined by an OpenAPI spec (also available as JSON). Use it to generate type-safe client SDKs in any language
Programmatically open and manage FDIC insured bank accounts at Column on behalf of your customers.
Our API sandbox is built to look and feel like the real thing. Every route is sandboxed and data persists exactly like in production.
most of our customers prefer the HTTP API's, which will likely remain the best way to use Column for a while.
